description: §39.2 / §14.8.10 — the live declaration of `assets` (WITH `tenant_id`) carries a comment inside its head (`CREATE TABLE assets /* live */ (…)`), and a commented-out stale copy WITHOUT `tenant_id` follows. A comment inside a head does not hide the declaration: both are declarations, they disagree on `tenant_id`, E-SCHEMA-015 (S450 fix round — the first cut lost the live head behind the copy and left the tenant floor off at exit 0).
rationale: §39.2: every table declaration in a `<schema>` body counts, however its head is spelled; same-name declarations that disagree on `tenant_id` SHALL be a compile error (E-SCHEMA-015). Provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S447 "stamp all" (i).
